title: Row work upper bound
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $\ell$, the work assigned to $n$ small-bias rows at degree $\ell$ is at most $n\bigl(\ell+n(W(\ell)+1)+2\ell+1\bigr)$, where $W(\ell)$ is the binary modular multiplication work at degree $\ell$.
